title: Project Alpha

overview.text: A comprehensive document analysis platform that leverages large language models to extract insights, summarize content, and answer questions about uploaded documents. Built with a FastAPI backend and React frontend, it supports PDF, DOCX, and plain text files with real-time streaming responses.

userManual: Getting Started 1. Upload a document using the drag-and-drop zone 2. Wait for the processing indicator to complete 3. Use the chat interface to ask questions 4. Export results using the download button Supported Formats PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV
devNotes: Architecture Microservices pattern with RabbitMQ message queue Stack Python, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Redis Challenges Handling large PDF parsing efficiently required chunking strategy with overlap for context preservation.
